# Backpack Ascendancy

> Backpack Ascendancy (v2.2.3) is a spatial inventory-management roguelike RPG on iOS, Android, and Steam where packing weapons, quivers, shields, summons, and magical glyphs on a grid creates real-time combat synergies.

## Core Facts (Version 2.2.3)
- Genre: Tactical Inventory Management Roguelike RPG (Offline Single-Player & 2-Player Online Co-Op)
- Items & Gear: 250 unique grid items across 24 equipment families, forging and merging up to +15
- Meta-Progression: 203-star Ascendancy constellation tree (including keystones & Corrupted pacts)
- Playable Heroes: 4 classes (Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Summoner), each with distinct base stats, perks, starter kit, and active Hero Power
- Biomes & Enemies: 239 enemies across 6 handcrafted stages (Dungeon, Forest, Desert, Crystal Cave, Earth's Core, Oblivion), plus Endless Mode, Weekly Challenges, Ancient Trials, and Corrupted Map Nodes
- Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, German (7 languages)
